title: 第3章 毒酒第4章 改命重生
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
数不清已经过了多少个夜晚，记忆一直停留在那一刻。那对樱落来说是一场噩梦，仿佛会一直做下去，一辈子也不会结束的噩梦……
当她从噩梦中清醒的时候，她的脑子里就剩下一个念头：
皇上他走了……
他真的走了……
先皇驾崩的太突然，令她始料未及。
漫漫长夜，吞噬着人的内心，就像在黑暗中摸索却总是找不到正确的方向。
冰冷潮湿的灵堂里，樱落蜷着身子，缩在角落，杏子般的眼睛里一片漆黑，月光照进去，眼眸里已经没有一点光彩。
她的身上已经换上了一袭白色素衣，抱着先皇的灵位，将它深深埋入怀中，不作任何言语，伴随着无边的黑暗似要将她吞噬。
多么希望这只是一场梦，醒来，皇上还是那个和她初识时意气风发的少年，笑容缱绻的对自己说——
“落落，我在这。”
樱落呆呆的伴在先帝的灵堂之前，泪水早已流干，心痛得几乎无法呼吸。
回想起自己和先帝的一生，只觉得心中悲凉。
自己由一届民间孤女，入宫选为天妃，成为天玑国的大祭司，风光无限，享尽荣华，全都是因为皇上的恩宠。
可是现在，皇上走了，她一个人要怎么办？……
“小落，小落……你振作一点好不好？人死不能复生，他也不愿意见到你这副模样！”
不知什么时候，冰冷月色下，一名男子站在自己面前，身上青衣被吞并夜色的寒风微微撩起，双手拼命摇晃着她的肩膀。
樱落微微回过神来，对上一双熟悉黯淡的冷眸。
眼前的人正是她从小到大的玩伴，也是先皇下令一起赶出皇宫——她的贴身侍卫，花无忧。
除了皇上，花无忧是在这冰冷的皇宫中，唯一能给她安慰的人。
不过，他终究不是皇上。

“无忧哥哥，你不必再劝我，皇上走了，我的心也跟着他一起死了，现在只想多陪陪他……再陪他一会儿……”
“可你已经这样，不吃不喝三天了！”
花无忧有些焦急地看着樱落，扣住她的皓腕。
“小落，跟我走吧，忘掉这里的一切……离开皇宫，去我的家乡——瑶国，过逍遥自在的日子。”
顿了顿，花无忧又补充道：“这也是皇上所希望的，你明白吗？”
说到这些，樱落内心不是没有感触。
花无忧的母国其实是瑶国，当初为了护她周全，和为亲人报仇，这才远离家乡来到天玑。
遗憾的是，花无忧陪她入宫十几载，可如今还是一个小小的侍卫，樱落心中愧疚。
还有收养樱落的亲人，早已在皇上还未掌权之时，为了保护她，在残酷的权谋斗争中而命丧皇宫。
这些桩桩件件，都和敬嫣皇后脱不了干系！
当初皇上一举夺下江山，十里红妆，许诺立她为后。
然而敬嫣皇后凭借着显赫的家世，父亲为大将军，给天玑立下赫赫战功，被众臣们力荐为皇后。
为了皇上的江山稳固，樱落退让了。
不然，不会是现在这样的局面！
后来，自己依然独得圣宠，然而敬嫣皇后险恶，一碗红花害得自己失去龙子，再不能生育！
一想到这些，樱落几乎咬碎了牙齿，恨恨的喊出：“不……我不甘心！”
她不甘心就这样任人宰割！
为什么，这一世陪伴在皇上身边的人是敬嫣皇后？
content_en:
I can’t count how many nights have passed, but the memory has always stayed at that moment. That was a nightmare for Yingluo, a nightmare that seemed to go on forever and would never end...
When she woke up from the nightmare, there was only one thought left in her mind:
The Emperor is gone...
He is really gone...
The death of the late emperor was so sudden that she did not expect it.
The long night engulfs people's hearts, like groping in the dark but never finding the right direction.
In the cold and damp mourning hall, Yingluo curled up and huddled in the corner, her apricot-like eyes were dark, and the moonlight shone in, and there was no luster in her eyes.
She had already put on a white plain dress, holding the late emperor's spiritual tablet, burying it deeply in her arms without saying a word, as the boundless darkness seemed to swallow her up.
How I hope this is just a dream. When I wake up, the emperor is still the same high-spirited young man when he first met her, smiling sweetly and saying to himself -
"Luoluo, I'm here."
Yingluo stood blankly in front of the late emperor's mourning hall, her tears had long since dried up, and she was so heartbroken that she could hardly breathe.
Looking back on the life of myself and the late emperor, I just feel sad in my heart.
She went from being an orphan girl to being a concubine in the palace, and became the high priest of the Tianji Kingdom. She enjoyed endless glory and splendor, all because of the emperor's favor.
But now that the emperor is gone, what will she do alone? …
"Xiaoluo, Xiaoluo... can you cheer up? People can't be resurrected, and he doesn't want to see you like this!"
At some point, under the cold moonlight, a man stood in front of her. His green clothes were slightly lifted by the cold wind that swallowed the night, and his hands shook her shoulders desperately.
Ying Luo came back to her senses slightly and met a pair of familiar and dim cold eyes.
The person in front of her was her playmate since she was a child, and she was also driven out of the palace under the order of the late emperor - her personal guard, Hua Wuyou.
Apart from the emperor, Hua Wuyou was the only person who could give her comfort in this cold palace.
However, he is not the emperor after all.
"Brother Wuyou, you don't have to persuade me anymore. The emperor has left, and my heart has died with him. Now I just want to stay with him... and stay with him for a while longer..."
"But you're already like this, not eating or drinking for three days!"
Hua Wuyou looked at Yingluo anxiously and clasped her Hao wrist.
"Xiaoluo, come with me, forget everything here...leave the palace, go to my hometown - Yao Kingdom, and live a free and easy life."
After a pause, Hua Wuyou added: "This is also what the Emperor wishes, do you understand?"
Speaking of this, Yingluo was not without feelings in her heart.
Hua Wuyou's mother country is actually the Yao Kingdom. In order to protect her and avenge her relatives, she left her hometown and came to Tianji.
Unfortunately, Hua Wuyou had accompanied her to the palace for more than ten years, but now she was still a little guard, which made Yingluo feel guilty.
And the relatives who adopted Yingluo had already died in the palace in a cruel power struggle to protect her before the emperor came to power.
All of these things are inseparable from Queen Jingyan!
Back when the emperor had conquered the country in one fell swoop, he promised to make her his queen.
However, Queen Jingyan relied on her prominent family background, her father was a general, and she had made great military exploits for Tianji, so she was highly recommended as the queen by all the ministers.
In order to stabilize the emperor's empire, Yingluo gave in.
Otherwise, the situation would not be like this!
Later, he was still the only one favored by the Holy Spirit, but Queen Jingyan was so sinister that a bowl of red flowers caused him to lose his son and become infertile!
Thinking of this, Yingluo almost gritted her teeth and shouted angrily: "No...I won't accept it!"
She is not willing to let others slaughter her like this!
Why is Queen Jingyan the one accompanying the emperor in this life?
